components.name: Attachment / AttachmentList
components.description: File chips for prompts and messages. `Attachment` renders one file; `AttachmentList` renders a wrapping row. Display-only: upload and file-system logic stay in the consumer.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A user profile image component with fallback support and accessible image loading

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small status indicator component for displaying tags, counts, or status information

components.name: Branch
components.description: Variant navigation for branched messages: previous/next arrows with an N/M position indicator.

components.name: Button
components.description: A clickable button component with variants for different visual styles and sizes

components.name: ChainThought
components.description: Displays ordered reasoning steps with status indicators.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.description: Syntax-highlighted code block with language label and copy-to-clipboard button.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.description: Cmd+K style command palette with lexical search, sectioned results and full keyboard navigation

components.name: Confirmation
components.description: Human-in-the-loop approval gate for agent actions. Pauses execution until the user approves or rejects.

components.name: Conversation
components.description: A container for displaying a list of chat messages with auto-scroll and loading states

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Accessible modal dialog with focus trapping, escape-to-close and focus restoration

components.name: InlineCitation
components.description: Perplexity-style inline citation chip that reveals the source title and snippet on hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: Input
components.description: A text input field with support for various input types and standard HTML input attributes

components.name: Message
components.description: A chat message component that displays messages from users, assistants, or system prompts with optional avatars

components.name: MessageActions
components.description: Feedback toolbar for an AI response: copy to clipboard, thumbs up/down rating, and regenerate. Every action is a callback; the component holds no conversation state.

components.name: PromptInput
components.description: A textarea input for entering chat prompts with auto-resize, keyboard shortcuts, and send button

components.name: Reasoning
components.description: A collapsible component for displaying AI reasoning steps and chain-of-thought processes

components.name: Response
components.description: Streaming-optimized markdown renderer for AI responses with GFM support, streaming-safe repair of incomplete syntax, and highlighted code blocks with copy.

components.name: Select
components.description: Accessible select primitive built on the native select element with controlled and uncontrolled modes

components.name: Source / Sources
components.description: Displays citations and references for an AI response. `Source` renders a single citation; `Sources` renders a numbered list with an overflow count.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Indeterminate loading indicator with accessible status semantics.

components.name: StreamingIndicator
components.description: Shows that an AI response is currently streaming.

components.name: Suggestions
components.description: Displays clickable follow-up prompts for AI interactions.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Accessible app-level notifications announced through a polite live region, with auto-dismiss, stacking and optional actions

components.name: ToolCall
components.description: A component for displaying AI tool/function calls with status, arguments, and results
